# ffxf_vpcs (Data Source)

Lists private networks and the account quota.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ffxf = {
      source = "ffxfnet/ffxf"
    }
  }
}

provider "ffxf" {}

data "ffxf_vpcs" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `quota` (Number) Maximum number of private networks for this account.
- `vpcs` (Attributes List) Private networks in this account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpcs))

<a id="nestedatt--vpcs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpcs`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) Private IPv4 range.
- `created_at` (String) UTC creation time.
- `gateway` (String) Network gateway address.
- `id` (Number) Numeric VPC identifier.
- `internet_gateway` (Boolean) Whether internet egress is enabled.
- `members` (Attributes List) Virtual machines connected to this network. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpcs--members))
- `name` (String) Network name.
- `region` (String) Network region.
- `status` (String) Network status.

<a id="nestedatt--vpcs--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpcs.members`

Read-Only:

- `configuration` (String) Network configuration mode.
- `hostname` (String) Virtual machine hostname.
- `ip` (String) Private IP address.
- `vm` (Number) Virtual machine identifier.
